operator_fields.operator_summary: Episode 15 does not fail because the doctrine stopped working. It fails because the seam contract becomes self-conflicting: episode 14 ends by strongly opening a gold next-gate, while episode 15 hard constraints demand a WTI 80-dollar prophecy and the replay guard forbids reusing the same office/phone confrontation surface. All ten retries die in replay reroute before any artifact is accepted.
